page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. This virtual machine features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core, alongside a bundled 446 GB local SSD storage volume. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates modest processing capabilities. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng falls within the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10%. However, the processor achieves average performance in PassMark CPU and extended instruction tests. Memory read bandwidth is generally weak, though large-block write bandwidth reaches average levels.

The inclusion of dedicated cores and local SSD storage makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring consistent compute allocation and local data caching. Given its performance profile, the ecs.i1.2xlarge is best positioned for general-purpose workloads, basic database operations, and lightweight web serving where extreme CPU throughput is not the primary requirement.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance featuring 8 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU cores operating at 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, a bundled 446 GB local SSD, and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Benchmark results indicate modest overall performance, with stress-ng CPU tests and memory read bandwidth placing in the bottom 25%, while PassMark CPU scores and large-block memory write bandwidth reach average levels. Lacking a GPU, this instance is designed for workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local storage without requiring high-compute density. It is best suited for general-purpose applications, moderate database tasks, and static web serving.
